meta.name: Monthly Report with Comparison
meta.description: Pick a period and a comparison period follows it; sessions, users and pageviews are shown now, before and the difference

msg.welcome: Choose a period. Use 'Compare' in the calendar to choose how the comparison period is decided (preceding period, last year, etc.). It starts with 'Preceding period'.
msg.head: **Current period** = {$period_start} - {$period_end} ({$period_days} days) / **Comparison period** = {$period_compare_start} - {$period_compare_end} ({$period_compare_days} days)
msg.note: Difference = now - before. Users are the sum of daily users (the same count as the Visits report total).
msg.partial: Part of the comparison period ({$period_compare_start} - {$period_compare_end}) has no data, so the comparison is not shown.
msg.no_prev: The comparison period ({$period_compare_start} - {$period_compare_end}) has no sessions, so the comparison is not shown.
msg.error: Could not load the data. Please try again.
